about: Real AI news a person picked from a trusted site (scripts/news.py TRUSTED). Each item gives the page's own words to check, word for word, and the date the page shows. Nothing here changes any number until a person approves it on the Futures page. Never add an item you have not opened yourself; the check marks anything it cannot find on the page as not verified.

items.title: Rails testing on autopilot: Building an agent that writes what developers won't
quotes: It reads Rails source files, generates or improves RSpec tests, validates them against style rules and coverage targets, and runs inside a CI/CD pipeline with no human intervention.
